question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**crushing**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**crushing**'.
 
• The sentence expresses that the chicken was destroyed as the peasant accidentally dropped a heavy sack on it. (वाक्य व्यक्त करता है कि मुर्गी को नष्ट कर दिया गया था क्योंकि किसान ने गलती से उस पर एक भारी बोरी गिरा दी थी)
 
• It means **'to press something very hard so that it is broken or its shape is destroyed'.** (किसी चीज को बहुत जोर से दबाना जिससे वह टूट जाए या उसका आकार नष्ट हो जाए)
 
 
• *Example: Add three cloves of **crushed** garlic.*

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *"****crushing** it to death..."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Covering**: something that covers the surface of something. (आवरण, चादर, जिल्‍द)
 
• **Creeping**: to move very quietly and carefully so that nobody will notice you. (चुपचाप और सावधानी से चलना ताकि और कोई देख न सके; चुपके-से खिसकना)
 
• **Crumbling**: to break or make something break into very small pieces. (टुकड़े-टुकड़े हो जाना या कर देना)
